Recorded claim:
A completed VPAT becomes an ACR; there is no VPAT certification. Every Level A/AA row needs a response and explanatory remarks using Supports, Partially Supports, Does Not Support, or Not Applicable. WCAG2ICT is the relevant desktop-software guidance. [Task 1]
